200.description: An existing classification for this SKU was replaced.

schema.description: SKU-level master data describing how an item must be handled, independent of any StockUnit or bin. This service owns it as source of truth (ADR 0009). dotHazardClass adds a same-bin DOT segregation check enforced at stow time (ADR 0010).

dotHazardClass.description: Omitted/null unless handlingTags includes Hazmat AND a DOT hazard class was explicitly recorded (ADR 0010).
